risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified and presents strong earnings and loan growth, but its tone is moderated by rising nonperforming assets, unrealized securities losses, increased FHLB borrowings, and pressure in office and assisted-living portfolios. Boilerplate forward-looking disclaimers and emphasis on adjusted results somewhat soften the presentation of these risks.
